content.comment_body: Hello, my previous computer broke and I had to get a new one. Unfortunately, I lost the original installation CD for the [product_name] software. Is there a way to get the full version of this software again, rather than a demo?
Welcome to the forum. Yes, it is possible to purchase the software again. The order number is [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: A user misplaced their physical installation CD for [product_name] after a PC failure and is looking for a way to reinstall the complete software, not just a demo. The situation emphasizes challenges related to relying on physical media and the need for an easier process to recover or reinstall purchased software in such cases.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to regain access to the full version of [product_name] without needing to buy it again, preferably via a digital download or an official recovery option.
